query: What statistical tests, significance thresholds, and multiple-comparison controls should we pre-register for model comparisons and leaderboard rankings to prevent p-hacking?

response.query: What statistical tests, significance thresholds, and multiple-comparison controls should we pre-register for model comparisons and leaderboard rankings to prevent p-hacking?
response.answer: Pre-register ANOVA for model comparisons, set significance at p < 0.05, and use Bonferroni correction for multiple-comparison controls.

results.title: PNG Delegation learns from Madagascar's Vanilla Industry
results.content: A delegation from Papua New Guinea, including senior officers from central government agencies such as the Department of National Planning and Monitoring (DNPM), the Spice Industry Board (SIB) under the Department of Agriculture and Livestock (DAL), as well as Provincial Government and Administration Institutions in East and West Sepik, and a model vanilla farmer, visited Madagascar on an 11-day exposure visit, to learn from Madagascar’s vanilla industry sector. The exposure visit was arranged and supported by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), as part of the European Union-funded STREIT PNG Programme, aimed at promoting the development of vanilla value chain in Papua New Guinea. This exposure visit provided a unique and unprecedented opportunity for Papua New Guineans to have a first-hand experience and observe how the vanilla value chain has been regulated and planned at the policy level and how it operates at the production, processing, certification, and marketing stages on a commercial scale in Madagascar.
